name: agentspoppy
description: AgentsPoppy: the open, local-first permission broker for your own AWS. Apps and agents connect with a user-approved scope; AgentsPoppy holds the credentials locally, tracks what each app builds in the cloud, and lets you pause it or tear it down.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/extension-sdk packages/broker packages/client && npm run typecheck -w @agentspoppy/app
